g.text: H6 | PR / PF shot-inclusive RZ cost ratio
tol-only DF19 · PR exploratory n=8 | NATIVE_MIXED | allowance factor 10 | S4 corrected
Linear 1 Å / STO-3G; T=0.8; P=0; cos+sin full Hadamard wrapper; saved empirical shots for each candidate.
Theory is an expected cost under the declared model; compiled PR is a finite-sample mean. No CI or population guarantee.
Lower/upper are stored endpoints, not a confidence interval. Gaps are saved ineligibility; no values are filled.
RZ only; excludes state preparation and FTQC. Ratio < 1 favours PR; > 1 favours PF.
